_comment: Output of the deterministic activation rules (AGENTS.md section 4a) before the Meta-Controller adapts it. Shape of runs.activation_json and of `activation` in GET /runs/{id}/brief. Council judges are always on and not listed.

facts.evidence: dataset name absent from paper text

activation.reason: paper supplied; candidate search not required: paper supplied
paper + its own codebase: consistency check and mode
dataset supplied: profile and leakage check
codebase + dataset: adapt the code to the new data
paper + different dataset: transfer what-if; question frames the branches
on demand: woken by failed jobs
